cd /workspace/dev && cat > bench2.py << 'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, json, sys, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

# 4 run atoms (16) + 4 bit atoms -> product ~19712, shortest accepted word ~68
svcs = ['r0','r1','r2','r3','b0','b1','b2','b3'] + ['u%d'%i for i in range(16)]
args = [{'op':'contains','path':['r%d'%i]*16} for i in range(4)] + \
       [{'op':'contains','path':['b%d'%i]} for i in range(4)]
req = {'services': svcs, 'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':args}}],
       'queries':[[]]}
info = m.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
sigma = info['sigma']; atoms = info['atoms']; k = len(atoms)
tables, ts, widths = m.build_monitors(atoms, sigma, info['index'])
coltabs = [[tables[j][a] for j in range(k)] for a in range(sigma)]
t0=time.time(); states, trans = m.product_bfs(k, coltabs, sigma, m.TUPLE_CAP); t1=time.time()
n = len(states)
print('tuples', n, 'bfs %.2fs' % (t1-t0))
size = 1<<k; everything=(1<<size)-1
var_masks=[]
for i in range(k):
    mask=0
    for b in range(size):
        if b>>i&1: mask |= 1<<b
    var_masks.append(mask)
allow=0
for flag, tree in info['rules']:
    allow |= m.expr_mask(tree, var_masks, everything)
accepted = allow
truth=[(accepted>>b)&1 for b in range(size)]
bit_tabs=[]
for i in range(k):
    col=[0]*widths[i]; col[ts[i]]=1<<i; bit_tabs.append(col)
from operator import getitem
accept=[truth[sum(map(getitem,bit_tabs,t))] for t in states]
print('accepting states', sum(accept))

# unbounded Moore, counting rounds
part = accept[:]; blocks = 2 if 0<sum(accept)<n else 1
if blocks==1: part=[0]*n
rounds=0
t0=time.time()
while True:
    rounds+=1
    getter=part.__getitem__; marks={}; newp=[0]*n; c=0
    for q in range(n):
        sig=(part[q],)+tuple(map(getter,trans[q]))
        i=marks.get(sig)
        if i is None: i=c;c+=1;marks[sig]=i
        newp[q]=i
    if c==blocks or c==n:
        part=newp; blocks=c; break
    part=newp; blocks=c
t1=time.time()
print('moore rounds', rounds, 'final blocks', blocks, 'time %.2fs'%(t1-t0))

# hopcroft from scratch
t0=time.time(); p2,b2 = m.hopcroft(n, sigma, trans, accept[:], 2); t1=time.time()
print('hopcroft from scratch %.2fs blocks %d'%(t1-t0,b2))

# hopcroft after R moore rounds
for R in (20, 48):
    part=accept[:]; blocks=2
    for r in range(R):
        getter=part.__getitem__; marks={}; newp=[0]*n; c=0
        for q in range(n):
            sig=(part[q],)+tuple(map(getter,trans[q]))
            i=marks.get(sig)
            if i is None: i=c;c+=1;marks[sig]=i
            newp[q]=i
        if c==blocks or c==n:
            part=newp; blocks=c; break
        part=newp; blocks=c
    t0=time.time(); p3,b3 = m.hopcroft(n, sigma, trans, part, blocks); t1=time.time()
    print('hopcroft after %d rounds: %.2fs blocks %d'%(R,t1-t0,b3))
PYEOF
